subject: Discovery recap + proposed trial trajectory
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Torres <emily.torres@luminateretail.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 14:08:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap + proposed trial trajectory

Hi Emily —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and a proposed two-week trial trajectory so we can align on success criteria, owners, and timeline. High level: Luminate wants reliable extraction of product attribute updates from customer support tickets and a reranking step to prioritize likely issues for ops.

What we captured (please correct if I missed anything):
- Success criteria (quantitative): 1) Extraction F1 >= 0.88 on a 500-message eval set; 2) Reranker improves precision@10 for urgent tickets by >= 12 percentage points vs. current baseline; 3) End-to-end 95th pct latency < 450ms for support web UI flows.
- Scope: ingest 30k historical ticket snippets (anonymized), run a 2-week trial on a staging copy of your UI with a lightweight API integration (no changes required to your backend beyond a single webhook).
- Roles/owners: Emily (Luminate) — data delivery & success sign-off; Marissa (Redwood) — trial lead and evaluation; Rafael (Redwood) — integration engineer; Ben (Redwood) — pricing/contract questions.
- Timeline (proposed):
   * Week 0 (this week): sign POC scope + data readiness confirmation
   * Week 1 (kickoff): integration & baseline run (3 days), evaluate extraction model on held-out set
   * Week 2 (tuning + reranker): iterate on prompts/config, run comparison metrics, final sign-off on Friday

Open items we need from Luminate to start:
1) Anonymized sample of ~1k tickets and a data schema (fields + types) — ETA?
2) Security questionnaire answers (we can start with a short SOC2 evidence packet) — who on your side owns this?
3) PO/contract cadence — Ben can pick this up once scope is agreed.

Attachments: POC-scope-v0.2.pdf (draft scope), data-sample-schema.csv (example schema).

Next steps: if that looks right, can you confirm data ETA and an internal decision owner for security by EOD Monday? If yes we’ll lock Feb 1 kickoff window and send a DocuSign for scope.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: POC-scope-v0.2.pdf (PDF, 412KB)]
[Attachment: data-sample-schema.csv (CSV, 8KB)]

From: Emily Torres <emily.torres@luminateretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Leigh Hammond <leigh.hammond@luminateretail.com>
Date: Sun, 24 Jan 2027 09:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed trial trajectory

Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough recap, this matches our notes. A few clarifications and constraints on our side:
- Data ETA: we can provide the anonymized 1k sample and schema by Friday, Jan 29. Full 30k export will take additional approvals and likely won’t be ready for the initial kickoff (legal + data governance).
- Security: Leigh will handle the SOC2 evidence; she asked if you can share a minimal evidence pack (SOC2 summary + access control diagram) — that would speed approvals.
- Success criteria: the extraction F1 target looks ambitious but reasonable. Could we add a qualitative acceptability check (sampling of 50 predictions for false positives/negatives) as part of the sign-off?
- Procurement: we have a standard short-form MSA; procurement wants to see estimated monthly spend for the two-week trial (ballpark).

If we shift the timeline to treat Week 1 as a pilot with limited data (10k or a smaller window) and plan a longer integration phase for the remainder, would that be acceptable?

I'll confirm that Leigh will handle security and will follow up with the anonymized sample on Jan 29.

—Emily
Emily Torres
Product Ops, Luminate Retail

- Add a qualitative review step (50-sample manual check) to the sign-off criteria.
- Rafael will prepare a short ingest script and test harness so you don’t need to modify your backend.
- Ben will provide a conservative spend estimate for the trial (ballpark) by Wednesday.

I’ve attached an updated POC scope that reflects the pilot approach and the qualitative check. If that looks good, please sign the attached DocuSign (link below) and confirm Leigh as the security owner so we can share the minimal SOC2 evidence pack.

Proposed kickoff window: Tue Feb 1 — Thu Feb 3 (flexible; we’ll work around your calendar). If you can confirm one 60–90 minute slot, Rafael and I will run the integration session and baseline run.

Quick internal note — I’ll own the integration and data ingest for the Luminate pilot. Plan:
1) Deliver a one-click ingest script (Python) that accepts the sample CSV and posts to a staging endpoint.
2) Stand up a small baseline harness that computes F1/precision@k so Marissa can run the evaluation quickly after kickoff.
3) ETA for scripts & harness: 48 hours after we get the 1k sample.

I’ll also validate tokenization edge cases with the sample (dates, SKU formats). Will flag anything that looks like PII to the legal team.

—Rafael

2) Confirm a 60–90 minute kickoff slot on Feb 1 or Feb 2 (we suggested Feb 1 earlier) so Rafael can run integration and we can do the baseline run that afternoon.
